name: @retroplug/audio
description: The host's audio: one interface a backend fills (AudioBackend / AudioStream), the null device, and AudioHost - the open / start / stop / reconfigure sequence, the muted fallback with a status, render-ahead and the stats. PortAudio and SDL2 fill the interface in packages of their own. Its TS half is config.json's `audio` section (the saved backend, driver, device, rate, block and width) and the Settings > Audio rows over it.
